version: Bridge West shaker-informed equivalent physical mass update v1
calibration_source: 2024/2025 shaker low-force modal frequencies and 2025 four-station shaker shapes only
policy: The sourced static total-mass inventory is not redefined. The update acts only on the dynamic FE mass matrix: a calibrated fraction of the residual nonstructural track/ballast mass participates in the shaker-frequency response, and a calibrated fraction of that participating mass is redistributed transversely from the tributary deck distribution to the two outer girder/deck lines while preserving every longitudinal x-slice mass. No 2022 or 2025 train strain, static weighing, target strain, or PLS displacement is used to identify these two parameters.
